newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish govt body approves three special econ zones.
newsitem.headline: Polish govt body approves three special econ zones.

text.p: The Polish government's economic committee approved on Monday the creation of three new special economic zones which will provide tax breaks for new businesses, the government press office said in a statement.

It said the new zones, to exist for 20 years, would be located in the south-western Legnica, central Lodz and souther-western Walbrzych provinces to help curb unemployment there and restructure the industry in these regions.
